@@ -42,7 +42,7 @@ check_katacoda_and_setup_code_server() {
 	if [ -d /opt/.katacodacode ]; then
 		echo "Setting up code server..."
 
-		[ -d /opt/.katacodacode/user-data/User ] || $SUDO mkdir --parents /opt/.katacodacode/user-data/User
+		[ -d /opt/.katacodacode/user-data/User ] || $SUDO mkdir -p /opt/.katacodacode/user-data/User
 
 		# (replace) vscode setting with link
 		[ -f /opt/.katacodacode/user-data/User/settings.json ] && $SUDO rm /opt/.katacodacode/user-data/User/settings.json

@@ -16,8 +16,8 @@ install_jetbrains_tool() {
 	JB_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/JetBrains"
 	PRODUCT_DIR="${JB_DIR}/${Product}${MAJOR_VERSION}"
 
-	test -d "${HOME}/.local/bin" || mkdir --parents "${HOME}/.local/bin"
-	test -d "${PRODUCT_DIR}" || mkdir --parents "${PRODUCT_DIR}"
+	test -d "${HOME}/.local/bin" || mkdir -p "${HOME}/.local/bin"
+	test -d "${PRODUCT_DIR}" || mkdir -p "${PRODUCT_DIR}"
 
 	echo "Downloading ${DL_LINK}..."
 	curl -L "${DL_LINK}" | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C "${PRODUCT_DIR}"
